Gold: Total: 3000g (Base: 650g, Sell: 2100g)
Stats: Ability Power: 55, Critical Strike Chance: 25%, Move Speed: 4%
Tags: CriticalStrike, SpellDamage, CooldownReduction, NonbootsMovement

[Passive] Wrath and Ruin: On spell cast, gain 2.5% Critical Strike Chance for 6 seconds, stacking up to 20%.

[Passive] Salvage the Wreckage: Your spells have a chance equal to your Critical Strike Chance to grant you or your targeted ally a shield for for 3s.
